description:
Alpha Centauri: the closest star system to Earth, and the next frontier we’re aiming for.

We are in Vienna taking on the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. We’re building a browser game where kids aged 7 to 12 take command of a lunar outpost. Power, oxygen, radiation shielding: every decision has a cost, and the space weather runs on real NASA data.

One weekend. Let’s launch.
